author: agent
text: Review follow-up: verify_person is snapshot-only (docstring says so). It cannot prove rotation: a change that retires all old keys and adds a new one signed only by the new key passes (takeover / rollback). Owner question open: should check require a key current in the previous committed person file to sign any key-set change? Revoked-but-unretired keys: verify_person does not consult revocations; proposed check policy is that a person file listing a revoked key as current is invalid. Added test: missing ssh-keygen -> VouchError, not bad-signature.
